input.prompt: Slow, steady top-down aerial drone shot, camera looking straight down, gliding gently forward and to the right at constant low speed, following the strokes of four giant characters formed by terraced rice fields. Golden hour sunlight. Wisps of cloud drift slowly below the camera, water in the flooded terraces glints and sparkles in the sun, soft ocean waves roll onto the beaches. The landscape is completely solid and static: the giant character shapes, terraces, rivers, roads, villages and coastline never move, morph or change shape; only the camera moves, smoothly, with no cuts. Photorealistic, natural colors, 4K drone documentary footage.
